name: 5dive
description: Plugins bundled with the 5dive CLI itself. Registered automatically, resolvable with no network — the reference marketplace for the 5dive plugin contract.

plugins.name: voice
plugins.description: Speak with your agent and hear it talk back — local speech-to-text and text-to-speech. The reference implementation of the 5dive plugin contract: a channel-capability plugin, the shape every later channel plugin copies.

plugins.name: browser
plugins.description: Operate a site as yourself — a dedicated browser profile you log into once by hand, then deterministic adapters that decide where to click. The agent is granted the session, never the credentials.
